war_summary: War 139 is on day 131 with no winner. Colonials hold a dominant strategic position with approximately 200 bases to Wardens' 60 across 40 regions. The most intense combat zones are Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Endless Shore, Godcrofts, Marban Hollow, Onyx, Oarbreaker, Reaching Trail, and Speaking Woods, where both factions are sustaining heavy casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Callahans Passage shows extreme intensity (~1,000 casualties/hr per side) with 4 events/24h across 2 active bases and a latest event at 23:49 UTC. Clahstra has ~500-600 casualties/hr per side with 21 events/24h across 4 active bases, latest event at 01:01 UTC. Endless Shore has ~60-65 casualties/hr per side with 43 events/24h across 5 active bases, latest event at 03:01 UTC. Godcrofts has surged to ~150-180 casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and 14 events/24h across 5 active bases, latest event at 02:46 UTC. Marban Hollow has ~110-320 casualties/hr per side with accelerating Warden casualties and 10 events/24h across 3 active bases, latest event at 19:03 UTC. Onyx shows extreme intensity (~1,100-1,600 casualties/hr per side) with 11 events/24h concentrated on The Waif, latest event at 02:16 UTC. Oarbreaker has ~40-65 casualties/hr per side with cooling trends but 41 events/24h across 5 active bases, latest event at 02:01 UTC. Reaching Trail shows extreme accelerating Colonial pressure (~660 casualties/hr) against Warden-held bases with 0 events/24h. Speaking Woods has ~1,000-1,200 casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and 7 events/24h across 3 active bases, latest event at 20:16 UTC. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods and Reaching Trail. Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
